jobs.name: LOK
jobs.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: Kalistar V4 standalone character illustration, LOK.
Input images: Image 1 is the previous Lok identity and painterly-material reference ONLY; REPLACE its foundry setting, standing action and work clothes. Images 2 (Momo) and 3 (Valazar) are the mandatory painting style references only, never include their characters.
Primary request: LOK IS A DWARVEN KING SEATED ON HIS THRONE, EXTREMELY NERVOUS; the tension must be palpable. This is not a foundry scene.
Scene/backdrop: The oppressive throne chamber high in the Iron Tower of Durane. A heavy dark iron and carved stone throne, severe monumental pillars, restrained royal drapery and deep empty space. Cold high window light and a small, physically motivated warm torch reflection. A quiet political crisis, not a battle. Background subdued so the expression reads immediately.
Subject/action: A stocky adult dwarf king with very broad torso, stout shortened limbs, strong dwarven facial structure, close-cut dark brown hair, thick short beard with a small braid, recognizably related to the first reference. Tarnished decorative royal metal armor over deep muted red cloth, modest metal royal circlet, not a worker's apron. He sits pitched forward on the throne edge, both short legs and boots visibly grounded on the raised stone step. Both elbows tucked in; one bare hand grips the inner end of the throne armrest very tightly, knuckles pale and fingers tense, while the other hand grips a bunched fold of his robe over the knee. Do not spread his hands out to the picture edges.
Emotion: Threatened authority and fear beneath pride, not heroic rage or a relaxed regal pose. Contracted brow, clenched jaw, compressed mouth, anxious eyes darting toward an unseen doorway, raised rigid shoulders, a restrained trace of sweat catching the light. The empty space around the throne increases the sense of isolation. Make this interior moment the story.
Constraints: One head, exactly two arms and two legs, natural individual hands. No other prominent person. No factory, conveyor, forge, machinery lever, industrial labor, weapon attack, gore, sparks, magical blast, cartoon scowl or triumphant pose.
Style/medium: Match the approved Kalistar Momo and Valazar references: detailed narrative fantasy painting, visibly shaped brush strokes and broad painted color planes, tactile worn materials, selective sharp edges at the face and hands, softer atmosphere in the distance. Painterly, not a photograph, not glossy 3D, not anime. Emotion and physical storytelling are more important than spectacular effects.
Composition/output: One single full-bleed portrait illustration only, width:height 4:5 (prefer 1536 x 1920), intended for the 737 x 921 art window of a card assembled elsewhere. No card design. Face and crucial hand gestures must sit within the central 60 percent of width, with breathing room around them. Keep all important anatomy inside the image.
